messages:
maya: Quick share — ran speculative decoding runs on the 13B-artifact with q4_0 and q4_1 profiles, small batch smoke. Results look promising for latency but there's a small quality delta.

sam: Nice. numbers?

maya: baseline (no spec): avg latency 204ms/token, throughput 48 tok/s. spec@0.7 (two-stage, 32 prefetched tokens): avg latency 118ms/token, throughput 82 tok/s. ~1.7x throughput.

leo: that's solid. what's the quality hit?

maya: on our 1k validation prompts (mix of instruct + code), exact-match down 1.6% absolute, BLEU-ish proxy down 0.9. hallucination score (heuristic) up slightly for long-form.

carolina: do we have confidence intervals / run-to-run variance?

maya: ran 5 seeds. latency stable +-2ms, quality metrics have +-0.5% stdev. biggest reg is on multi-step math where the beam of speculative picks backtracks less often.

sam: can you paste the eval command and config? I want to reproduce locally.

maya: sure — run used this harness: 
```
python eval_runner.py --model artifacts/13b-q4_1 --speculative True --spec_threshold 0.7 --prefetch 32 --dataset valset-1k.jsonl --batch 8 --seed 42
```

maya: logging snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T10:02:13Z INFO throughput=82.3 tok/s latency=118.4ms spec_accept=0.62
2026-03-15T10:02:13Z INFO baseline_throughput=48.1 tok/s baseline_latency=203.7ms
```

leo: what's spec_accept? how often the speculative chunk was accepted?

maya: fraction of prefetched segments used without fallback. about 62%.

carolina: do we see a distribution by length? maybe short prompts benefit less?

maya: yes — improvements concentrated on medium-turn dialogs (200-600 tokens). for very short prompts (<40 tokens) overhead sometimes cancels gains.

sam: any regression tests flagged? ops needs a safety gate before enabling by default on hosted.

infra-bot: NOTE: canary deploy scheduled if feature flag 'speculative-decoding' is toggled; required: 2x eval runs, mem check, canary traffic <1%.

maya: next steps: 1) run larger 10k eval with stratified sampling; 2) re-run on q4_0 and q8_sparse to compare quant profiles; 3) add targeted math/problem-solving promptset to catch regressions; 4) perf microbench on Dedicated hardware (A100 vs H100).

sam: add an automated regression check in the eval pipeline — fail if exact-match drops >1% or hallucination >2% relative to pinned baseline.

carolina: agree. also let's add a per-model rollout plan: canary->pct-traffic->auto-fallback to baseline on increase in errors.

maya: filing a short PR with numbers + config in the onboarding checklist. ping me for reproducer. :+1:

leo: great work, thanks for the clear numbers.

maya: thanks all. will post the 10k run once finished.
